@graph.name: Data Engineering Course with Placement
@graph.description: A six-month, live online Data Engineering course: Python, SQL, Spark, AWS, Databricks, Airflow and Azure, with three CV-ready projects.

mainEntity.name: How long is the BrowseJobs Data Engineering course?

acceptedAnswer.text: Six months. Classes are live online, and you also get the recordings.

mainEntity.name: What will I learn in the Data Engineering course?

acceptedAnswer.text: Python, Pandas, SQL, Spark and PySpark, AWS, Databricks with Delta Lake, Airflow and Azure, plus a module that prepares you for real interviews. You finish with three projects for your CV.

mainEntity.name: Do I pay before I get a job?

acceptedAnswer.text: Registration is ₹30,000, paid after three free steps. The placement fee is your first three months' CTC (salary), due only after you accept a job offer.

mainEntity.name: Is a job guaranteed after the course?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Nobody can honestly guarantee a job, because the job market decides. What we put in writing is the process.
